title: Pay at least the Montgomery County minimum wage for 51+ employees[[ ({{wage.mcLarge}} an hour)]]
summary: [[As of {{wage.countyEffective}}, ]]large employers (51 or more employees) in Montgomery County must pay at least the county's large-employer rate[[ of {{wage.mcLarge}} per hour]]. Some 501(c)(3) nonprofits and home care providers pay the mid-size rate instead. Rates rise each July 1 with inflation.
action: Pay every employee at least the large-employer rate[[ ({{wage.mcLarge}})]] and display the Montgomery County minimum wage poster.
agency: Montgomery County Office of Human Rights
verify: Large employers (51 or more employees)

title: Don't ask about criminal records until after a job offer (Baltimore City)
summary: Baltimore City employers with the equivalent of 10 or more full-time employees can't ask about or check criminal records until after making a conditional job offer. Part-time staff count toward full-time equivalents. Employers serving minors or vulnerable adults are exempt.
action: Remove criminal record questions from applications and wait until after a conditional offer to run background checks.
verify: equivalent of ten or more full-time employees
offer of conditional employment
sourceName: Baltimore City Community Relations Commission: Ban the Box (Ordinance 14-221)

title: Renew your Calvert County food service license by October 31
summary: Calvert County food service facility licenses expire on October 31 each year.
action: Send your renewal and fee to the Calvert County Health Department before October 31.
verify: Licenses to operate a food service facility expires on October 31st
sourceName: Calvert County Health Department: Food service facility license application

title: Renew your Frederick County food service license by January 31
summary: Frederick County food service facility licenses expire on January 31. Renewal forms are mailed in December, and paperwork and fees received after January 31 get late fees.
action: Return your renewal paperwork and fee to the Frederick County Health Department by January 31.
verify: All Food Service Facility licenses expire on January 31
sourceName: Frederick County Health Department: Food facility license renewal

title: Renew your Cecil County food service license each year
summary: A Cecil County food service facility license is valid for one year from the date it was issued, so each business has its own renewal date.
action: Check the issue date on your license and renew with the Cecil County Health Department before it's a year old.
frequencyNote: One year from the date on your license
verify: A food service facility license is valid for one year based on the date of issuance
sourceName: Cecil County Health Department: Food safety
